strings.Nav_CaretLabel_Tooltip: Settings for the small language label that follows your text caret
strings.Nav_MouseLabel_Tooltip: Settings for the language label that follows your mouse cursor
strings.Nav_TaskbarStrip_Tooltip: Settings for the colored strip drawn over your taskbar to indicate the active layout
strings.Nav_IdleReset_Tooltip: Auto-switch the layout back to a target language when the keyboard has been idle for some time
strings.Caret_Subtitle: A small floating label that follows your text caret and shows the active keyboard layout. Useful while typing in mixed-language documents.
strings.Caret_PreviewHint: The label uses the language code from your first configured row, or 'EN' if none exists yet.
strings.Caret_Enable_Tooltip: Master switch for the caret label overlay.
strings.Caret_OffsetX_Tooltip: Pixels to shift the label to the right of the caret. Negative values move it to the left.
strings.Caret_OffsetY_Tooltip: Pixels to shift the label downward from the caret. Negative values move it up.
strings.Caret_FontFamily_Tooltip: Font family used to draw the label. Type to search; defaults to a system font if the chosen family is unavailable.
strings.Caret_FontSize_Tooltip: Font size of the label in points. Larger sizes are more visible but more intrusive.
strings.Mouse_Subtitle: A small label that follows your mouse cursor and shows the active keyboard layout. Handy in apps without a visible text caret.
strings.Mouse_Enable_Tooltip: Master switch for the mouse cursor label overlay.
strings.Mouse_OffsetX_Tooltip: Pixels to shift the label to the right of the cursor tip. Negative values move it left.
strings.Mouse_OffsetY_Tooltip: Pixels to shift the label downward from the cursor tip. Negative values move it up.
strings.Mouse_FontFamily_Tooltip: Font family used to draw the label.
strings.Mouse_FontSize_Tooltip: Font size of the label in points.
strings.Mouse_TrackingMode_Tooltip: Economy: the label only updates while the mouse moves; idle when at rest. Max-smoothness: marginally snappier first-frame response at higher background CPU/battery cost.
strings.Mouse_TrackingMode_Hint: Economy is recommended for laptops. Max-smoothness shaves a few milliseconds at the cost of constant background polling.
strings.Strip_Subtitle: A colored strip drawn over your taskbar, in the color you assigned to the active language. Glanceable from across the screen.
strings.Strip_PreviewHint: Preview uses the first configured color row. Add languages below to see the strip switch colors when the layout changes.
strings.Strip_Enable_Tooltip: Master switch for the taskbar color-strip overlay.
strings.Strip_Thickness_Tooltip: How tall the strip is. 'Full' covers the entire taskbar height and disables the vertical position option.
strings.Strip_VerticalPosition_Tooltip: Whether the strip sits at the top or bottom of the taskbar. Disabled when thickness is 'full'.
strings.Strip_ZOrder_Tooltip: 'Front': strip is drawn over taskbar icons (best visibility). 'Behind': strip is drawn under icons (subtler, but harder to see when icons overlap).
strings.Strip_ApplyTransparency_Tooltip: When on, the strip is drawn with the opacity below. When off, it is fully opaque.
strings.Strip_Opacity_Tooltip: 0% is fully transparent, 100% is fully opaque.
strings.Strip_ColorTableHint: Map each installed keyboard layout to a hex color (e.g. #FF0000). The strip shows the color for the currently active layout.
strings.Strip_AddLanguage_Tooltip: Add a new language → color mapping
strings.Idle_Subtitle: Automatically switch the keyboard layout to a chosen target when the keyboard has been idle for a while. Prevents typing in the wrong layout after walking away.
strings.Idle_PreviewHint: Triggered only when the keyboard is idle — mouse movement does not reset the timer.
strings.Idle_Enable_Tooltip: Master switch for automatically resetting the layout after idle time.
strings.Idle_Seconds_Tooltip: How long the keyboard must be idle before resetting. Minimum 5 seconds.
strings.Idle_Target_Tooltip: Two-letter language code the layout will reset to (e.g. 'en', 'he', 'ru').
strings.General_LaunchOnStartup_Tooltip: Adds OopsType to the Windows Run registry so it starts in the background when you sign in.
strings.General_TrayHint: OopsType runs in the system tray. Right-click the tray icon to open this window or quit.
strings.General_Language_Tooltip: Language used by the settings window and tray menu. Discovered automatically from JSON files in the 'Languages' folder.
strings.General_Language_Hint: Add a new language by dropping a JSON file into the 'Languages' folder next to OopsType.exe, or under %LOCALAPPDATA%\OopsType\Languages.
strings.Footer_Save_Tooltip: Persist current settings to disk and apply them to the running overlays.
strings.Dialog_UnsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
